declaration_note: Definitions fixed before any real per-event results. Timestamp obtained from the session UTC clock immediately after initial file creation and before implementation or audio analysis.
purpose: Diagnose the post-reveal perceived punch difference using existing final masters. No DSP change, rerender, perceptual validation, or production promotion.

detector.audio: source only; stereo mean-square energy, no channel cancellation
detector.score: 20 log10(current frame RMS / RMS over the preceding 40 ms); amplitudes floored at 1e-15 only for the detector logarithm
detector.plateau_rule: strictly greater than the preceding two scores, greater than or equal to the following two; earliest plateau frame wins
detector.selection: Boundary-valid above-threshold local maxima, greedily accepted by descending score then earliest frame; suppress candidates within 200 ms of an already accepted stronger event; return accepted events in time order
detector.onset_origin: start sample of the selected 5 ms input frame; no output-dependent refinement
detector.exclusions: Reject incomplete frames, missing history/local-peak neighbors, low input activity, below-threshold rises, non-local maxima, insufficient filter/window boundary support, and NMS suppression. Store every above-threshold active local maximum and its acceptance/exclusion reason. No output-based event selection.
detector.interpretation: Energy-rise proxy; not an instrument detector. Dense events can be suppressed and windows can contain other musical activity. Adjacent events and excerpt/full-song summaries are dependent.

window_semantics: Half-open sample ranges; ms are rounded to native sample counts once. The pre/attack gap and attack/sustain gap are deliberately unused. Require complete windows plus FIR half-support; no edge padding for accepted events.

filter.construction: ideal bandpass impulse response (difference of normalized sinc lowpasses) times symmetric Hamming window, unity response normalized at band midpoint
filter.application: float64 linear FFT convolution on one event patch and one recording at a time; centered odd FIR with delay removed; same coefficients and support for all three recordings
filter.caveat: Finite-transition bands and symmetric FIR pre/post ringing are diagnostic definitions, not exact acoustic stems or continuous-time bands. Peaks are native-sample peaks of the filtered signal, not true-peak estimates.

alignment.gate: All files must have exact declared geometry and all fifteen demeaned stereo normalized correlation searches must have best integer lag zero, correlation >=0.9 and margin >=0.001 outside +/-1 ms. Otherwise stop before event analysis. No alignment fitting or waveform shift. Integer-lag evidence on five anchors does not guarantee sub-sample or every-event alignment.

metrics.channel_pooling: RMS = sqrt(mean over both channels and samples); peak = max absolute over both channels and samples
metrics.paired: candidate minus control for every window dB metric and within-recording ratio; raw amplitude deltas are level-dependent; ratios and crest differences are invariant to positive uniform gain within either recording
metrics.source_relative: For each output retain the same within-recording ratios and their differences from the source. Source is a reference for window selection and change, not a clean target.
metrics.null_policy: Source window activity threshold = maximum input block RMS * 1e-5 (-100 dB amplitude). For a given ratio require both referenced source window RMS values above this floor; otherwise retain raw metrics but null the ratio in all three recordings with an explicit shared source-null reason. Output exact-zero denominators are separately flagged and paired ratios null; no output event is removed. Never clamp a nonzero ratio denominator.

subsets.prior_listening_excerpt_48_78s: source onset in [48, 78) seconds; same previously used excerpt, not an independent sample

summaries.inference: Descriptive paired distributions only. No event-level significance test, confidence interval, perceptual threshold, composite score, or superiority claim.

resources.memory_check: Read /proc/self/status VmHWM and resource.getrusage where available, stop if observed HWM exceeds 512 MiB
resources.array_policy: stream WAV in <=65536-frame blocks; one event/recording and one filtered band at a time; no full-song FFT or full-song float64 arrays
resources.dependencies: Python standard library and NumPy; SciPy availability checked and absent; no new package installation
resources.timing: Timestamps for provenance only, no speed experiment or timing claim

stopping: Any pin/geometry/finite/alignment/memory error stops and writes STOP.json; real pair is run once; no detector/threshold/band adjustment after results.
limitations: One source song, final masters only; cannot localize an effect to coherence, glue, or limiter stages.
Source attack positions have 5 ms frame resolution; symmetric filtering changes local waveform shape.
Fixed windows need not correspond to isolated physical attacks or sustained instruments.
Sampled metrics do not establish perceived punch/coherence, restoration, continuous-time behavior, or generalization.
